page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is a virtualized compute instance within the compute-optimized GPU family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 10 dedicated vCPUs across 5 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU architecture is x86_64, featuring 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, 33 MB L3 cache, and instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, FMA, BMI2, and AES. Memory capacity is configured at 46.0 GB, providing 4.6 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered via a shared accelerator configuration featuring a 0.5 NVIDIA T4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance features no local storage and maintains a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

Benchmark evaluations indicate polarized compute characteristics. Single-core performance falls in the lower tiers, demonstrated by a Geekbench single-core score of 913.0 and a single-core stress-ng result of 1110.19. Multi-threaded workloads show improved scaling, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 8589.71 and stress-ng multi-core throughput of 7390.5. Memory tests reveal an uncached read bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 43.85 GB/sec, alongside an average PassMark database score of 2766.32 and 7.2 million Redis SET operations per second. For machine learning, the partitioned 0.5 T4 accelerator handles small-scale models competently, registering 130.14 tokens per second on 135M parameter LLM text generation. However, larger workloads reveal hardware constraints, yielding only 6.09 tokens per second for 7B model generation.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances cost and resource density by slicing physical GPU hardware, avoiding the expense of a full discrete accelerator for modest visual or compute demands. The absence of local disk requires reliant configurations on cloud network block storage, influencing total storage I/O performance. The ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is best matched for virtual workstation infrastructure (VDI), moderate image and video rendering, software compilation tasks, and lightweight deep learning inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is a GPU-assisted compute instance designed for graphics-accelerated applications and lightweight parallel processing. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 10 dedicated vCPUs across 5 physical cores alongside 46 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by a partitioned NVIDIA T4 GPU allocating 8 GB of VRAM. Networking operates at a 4 Gbps baseline, and the instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. Benchmark results reflect modest single-core throughput alongside average multi-core processing, with 7.2 million Redis SET operations per second and stable static web serving at 6.94 GB/sec. While insufficient for large-scale AI models, evidenced by 6.09 tokens per second on 7B LLM generation, the fractional GPU architecture provides an economical entry point for virtual desktops, Clang compilation, image processing, and lightweight model inference.
